main.description: A repository's releases, of every package or of one, newest first, a page at a time: follow `cursor` until it is absent. Each marks whether it is its package's latest, and whether it is a container image. None for a private repository, which cannot publish, or from an appview that keeps no index. No authentication needed.

packages.description: Each package the repository publishes, by name, whatever `package` asked for, for a filter to name. Absent when it publishes none.

cursor.description: How many the pages before held.

package.description: Only this package's releases; every package's if absent.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record. Its authority may be a handle; a name the repository had before, or an owner it moved from with its agreement, finds it under the name it has now.
